macroWorld.seasonVisualPolicy: coordinate-equivalent Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter terrain, tree, plant, wildflower and cliff source regions are exact-source runtime substitutions; non-equivalent families remain evidence-gated
macroWorld.coastProfile: deep_ocean -> shallow_water -> sand -> inland grass; configured Tiled/native-Wang topology owns the live boundary; legacy WetSand/pale-shore evidence is reference-only

settlements.cityGoal: purposeful authored-feeling settlements rather than repeated random house stamps
settlements.currentPrototype: season-specific purpose anchors with class-correct house labels and deterministic nearby buildable-parcel fallback; Summer/Autumn remain denser while Spring/Winter stay smaller

roads.geometryGoal: meandering countryside routes that lead somewhere meaningful
roads.currentPrototype: one-cell warm dirt roads using the source-backed Dirt/Mud fill family; reviewed horizontal bridge only where a real road/water crossing exists; PebblePath remains a manual/POI material

caves.overworldPrototype: reviewed complete wide cave/cliff source section retained as a recipe; automatic entrance placement gated until continuous cliff faces own the entrance

sourceArt.currentCertifiedGroundAuthority: exact coordinate-equivalent Terrain/terrain_{spring,summer,autumn,winter}.png semantic-material authority; cliff sheets are never ordinary cell-ground authority
sourceArt.broaderLaneGoal: all 320 hydrated ElizaWy PNG sheets remain discoverable; visual repair now prioritizes correct crops/anchors/recipes before adding more automatic families

elevation.intent: season-specific terraces/ridges; generated elevation and cardinal cliff-drop masks are authoritative shared metadata; source-exact cliff visuals/collision/navigation will consume the same mask
elevation.cliffVisualPolicy: shared cliff topology is active as a 4-bit N/E/S/W elevation-drop mask per generated cell; source-art role classification/rendering is the next stage; waterfall/cave sprites remain gated until those continuous faces render

waterfalls.placement: reviewed south-facing body/splash recipe retained; automatic placement gated until continuous cliff faces provide a real drop
waterfalls.animation: static reviewed source frame for this pass; ordered animation semantics remain source-evidence-gated

population.rule: purpose-first special placements plus deterministic biome-aware scatter; water details route to Water, bank plants/wildflowers to Terrain Details, vegetation to Objects; lighting stays on road edges, bridges require real crossings, cliff-dependent waterfall/cave recipes remain gated, generated art remains forbidden

visualRepair.treeAtlasSampling: Full Gate derives v2 union-alpha render bounds across immutable Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter tree PNGs; runtime uses exact certified crops and normal half-pixel atlas sampling, with no tree-specific UV inset hack.
visualRepair.waterfallCrop: reviewed south-facing [0,32,96,128] body/splash retained; automatic placement gated until continuous cliff faces are active
visualRepair.caveCrop: reviewed complete [224,288,160,96] wide entrance retained; automatic placement gated until continuous cliff faces are active
visualRepair.bridgeAnchor: modular horizontal bridge measures a contiguous road/interior-water crossing, keeps one land approach cell on each side, and repeats the exact 32x64 middle source slice to span the river
visualRepair.bankPolicy: grass bank is the default around inland water; smooth clustered dirt-bank erosion is seasonal/sparse and isolated one-cell dirt hooks are rejected
visualRepair.sandPolicy: Generated coast is DeepWater -> RiverWater/Shallow Water -> Sand -> Grass. Legacy WetSand generation and the second pale-shore repaint are retired until Deep Sand/shore-animation evidence explicitly proves a replacement.
visualRepair.ownerSideTerrainTransitions: legacy owner-side families remain evidence/reference data only when Tiled/Wang resolves the live core terrain. Exact configured Tiled topology is attempted first, shared native-Wang repair handles sparse checkerboards across one materialized visual grid, and conservative compatibility fallback is used only when the configured/canonical lane cannot resolve.
visualRepair.coastNoise: seasonal island edge perturbation uses smooth deterministic interpolation across coarse lattice samples; no piecewise 5x5 score cells
visualRepair.paleShore: exact Summer pale-shore ring remains cataloged and browsable as historical source evidence, but it is no longer a live Water/WetSand compositor pass layered after Tiled terrain.
visualRepair.spatialReservation: purpose objects are emitted before ecology; structures reserve their footprint plus a one-cell visual/entrance margin and other purpose objects reserve their footprint before natural placement.
visualRepair.naturalObjectRenderBounds: Full Gate certifies exact immutable-alpha render crops for 7 seasonal tree templates and 2 grassland rock/stone templates; atlas slots remain provenance/placement identity while render/collision/depth contracts stay separate.
visualRepair.tiledRenderer: near and far terrain share one dual-grid vertex renderer; exact configured Tiled Terrain Wang topology maps back to canonical ElizaWy pixels; complete canonical TSX clips animate with stable world-space phase; unsupported legacy roles fail closed.

cliffDependentFeatures.reason: Do not stamp standalone cliff-dependent sprites onto flat ground.

cliffTopology.sourceArtState: topology active; exact cliff_summer role projection remains evidence/review gated

worldComposition.layerAuthority: Generated World partitions semantic terrain into Ground/TerrainDetails/Water and routes discrete placements through canonical Ground/TerrainDetails/Water/Elevation/Structures/Objects/Foreground ordering; object-layer peers depth-sort by ground foot.
worldComposition.objectDepthSort: layer rank, then anchorY + footprintHeight, then stable X/id tie-break; reviewed tall sprites may extend upward with negative part offsets while retaining a one-cell foot anchor
worldComposition.visualBoundsCulling: generated objects cull against complete source-part visual bounds and query an 8-cell neighbour margin so overhanging vegetation cannot disappear at chunk boundaries while panning
worldComposition.detailLod: minor-object overview LOD only hides at the absolute far zoom (<=4.05 px/cell) and restores at >=5.5 px/cell; expanded neighbour-chunk queries prevent pan-edge flashing
worldComposition.farTerrainLod: all zoom levels render the same cached dual-grid vertex topology; far zoom only reduces object/collision detail and never switches to GeneratedCell.source or a cell-top-left terrain grid
worldComposition.waterEcology: water context is explicit: Ocean/Coast/River/PondLake; lily pads are prohibited in Ocean/Coast, common in ponds/lakes, and sparse in rivers
worldComposition.waterAnimation: water-bearing Tiled Terrain animations only; synchronized shared clock removes chase-light phase gradients; presentation cadence is slowed by context (coast 4x, river 5x, pond/lake 7x)

collisionAuthority.reusableTerrainKey: semantic role + cardinal same-role topology mask
collisionAuthority.legacySourceProfiles: preserved for compatibility but inactive for generated-terrain collision/traversal
collisionAuthority.overlayPerformance: hidden below 6 px/cell; coarse cells below 16 px/cell; exact masks merge contiguous horizontal pixel runs at editing zoom

bridgeSystem.recipe: 32x64 left end + repeatable 32x64 middle + 32x64 right end, all exact slices from the reviewed 96x64 source region
bridgeSystem.placement: measure contiguous road/water run, include one land approach cell on each side, repeat middle to fit
bridgeSystem.traversal: generated bridge footprint overrides underlying water as walkable unless a local authored override exists
bridgeSystem.railLayerSplit: pending exact rail-only source-role certification; current modular recipe remains on Structures

terrainStudio.authority: same Summer owner-side runtime profile used by Generated World

hydrology.riverMouthPolicy: Spring/Summer/Autumn primary river corridors continue through the irregular island mask to shallow ocean; coastal shoulders resolve as Sand so river-bank and beach topology merge through the same configured Sand/Shallow-Water authority. Winter retains an inland feeder/lake profile.
